export declare const AGENT_QUESTION_PROBLEM_REASONS: readonly ["unknown-question", "answered-twice", "unanswered", "required", "wrong-shape", "unknown-option", "single-select", "duplicate", "other-not-allowed", "too-long", "not-a-number", "not-an-integer", "too-small", "too-large", "bad-date", "too-early", "too-late", "kind-not-allowed", "too-many"];

export declare const AGENT_QUESTION_TYPES: readonly ["choice", "text", "number", "date", "datetime", "reference"];

export interface AgentAnswerControl {
    kind: "answer";
    pending_id: string;
    pending_revision?: number;
    text?: string;
    answers?: ReadonlyArray<AgentQuestionAnswer>;
}

export interface AgentPendingQuestion {
    pending_id: string;
    pending_revision?: number;
    sequence?: number;
    kind: string;
    prompt: string;
    options: ReadonlyArray<{
        value: string;
        label: string;
    }>;
    allows_free_text: boolean;
    questions?: ReadonlyArray<AgentQuestion>;
    answerable?: boolean;
    unavailable_reason?: string;
}

export interface AgentQuestion {
    index: number;
    id?: string;
    prompt: string;
    type: AgentQuestionType;
    required: boolean;
    help?: string;
    options: AgentQuestionOption[];
    multiple: boolean;
    allow_other: boolean;
    default?: string | number | number[];
    multiline?: boolean;
    max_length?: number;
    min?: number | string;
    max?: number | string;
    integer?: boolean;
    ref_kinds?: string[];
    max_count?: number;
}

export interface AgentQuestionAnswer {
    question: number;
    indexes?: readonly number[];
    other?: string;
    value?: AgentQuestionValue;
}

export interface AgentQuestionOption {
    index: number;
    label: string;
    description?: string;
    recommended?: boolean;
}

export interface AgentQuestionProblem {
    question: number;
    id?: string;
    reason: AgentQuestionProblemReason;
}

export type AgentQuestionProblemReason = (typeof AGENT_QUESTION_PROBLEM_REASONS)[number];

export interface AgentQuestionReference {
    kind: string;
    id: string;
    label: string;
}

export type AgentQuestionType = (typeof AGENT_QUESTION_TYPES)[number];

export type AgentQuestionValue = string | number | readonly AgentQuestionReference[] | null;

export interface InteractionRequest {
    interaction_id: string;
    why: string;
    questions: AgentQuestion[];
    note?: string;
    html?: string;
}

export interface InteractionRequestResult {
    status: "needs_input";
    interaction: InteractionRequest;
}
